$comment: Amazon Associates compliance requirements. Every row cites an official source URL fetched on 2026-11-13.

requirements.detail: You must clearly and prominently state, on your Site: "As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases."
requirements.status_on_this_site: Implemented — shown in the footer of every page

requirements.requirement: Link-level disclosure must be clear and conspicuous
requirements.detail: Link-level disclosure must be Clear (e.g. "(paid link)", "#ad", "#CommissionsEarned") and Conspicuous (near the link/review, easy to notice).
requirements.source_title: Associates Help — Why do I have to identify myself as an Associate?
requirements.status_on_this_site: Implemented — affiliate links (when published) will carry a clear label

requirements.requirement: Use official Special Link formats only
requirements.detail: Links must properly use the special "tagged" link formats Amazon provides. Documented simple format: http://www.amazon.com/dp/ASIN/ref=nosim?tag=YOURASSOCIATEID
requirements.source_title: Associates Help — How do I build a simple text link to a specific item on Amazon?
requirements.status_on_this_site: Blocked pending Tracking ID — see flag F-12

requirements.detail: Session begins at the click and ends at the first of: 24 hours elapsed, an order placed, or a click through another Associate's Special Link. Cart purchases must complete no later than 89 days after the initial click-through (Program Policies).
requirements.source_title: Associates Program Policies — Commission Income Statement

requirements.detail: Commission income is calculated on the sale price, not the list price, of each qualifying item.
requirements.source_title: Associates Help — What items qualify for commission income, and how are the commissions calculated?

requirements.detail: Commission income is paid approximately 60 days after the end of the month in which it was earned.
requirements.source_title: Amazon Associates — FAQ (How do I earn in this program?)

requirements.detail: Disclosures must be placed so they are hard to miss, use simple and clear language (e.g. "advertisement", "ad", "sponsored"), and be in the same language as the endorsement.
requirements.source_title: FTC — Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers
requirements.status_on_this_site: Implemented — disclosure in footer + per-link labels

requirements.detail: If there is a connection between the endorser and the marketer that a significant minority of consumers would not expect, that connection should be disclosed clearly and conspicuously. Guides revised in 2023.
requirements.source_title: FTC — The FTC's Endorsement Guides: What People Are Asking

requirements.detail: Sites must have robust original content (rule of thumb: at least 10 posts), be publicly available, and website content should be recent (generally within the last 60 days). At least 3 qualified sales are required within the first 180 days of sign-up.
requirements.status_on_this_site: Content plan published (Buying Guides); product-specific posts pending verified products

requirements.detail: Creators API requires: Associates enrollment, at least 10 qualifying sales within the past 30 days, registration through Associates Central, and generated API credentials. Only the primary account owner can sign up.
requirements.source_title: Creators API — Introduction / Register for Creators API
requirements.status_on_this_site: Blocked until Associates account qualifies — see flag F-10

requirements.detail: PA-API 5 is deprecated and replaced by the Creators API; legacy calls receive HTTP 403 AccessDeniedException.
The disclosure must be made in the medium in which the recommendation was provided (text, voice, or both).
requirements.source_title: Associates Help — Why do I have to identify myself as an Associate?
